insight: Rebranded from CodiumAI in 2024, expanding from test generation into a multi-agent code-quality platform.
name: Qodo
tagline: AI code review and test generation across IDE, PRs, and CLI.
description: Qodo (formerly CodiumAI) is a code-quality platform that runs AI review on pull requests, generates tests, and assists inside the editor. Its multi-agent reviewer pulls context from the codebase and PR history across GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, and Azure DevOps, with VS Code and JetBrains plugins plus a CLI so issues surface before merge.

modelSupport.notes: Orchestrates multiple frontier models for review, chat, and test generation.

edge: Its multi-agent reviewer pulls context from prior PR history, not just the current codebase, across GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, and Azure.
